title: Edison "Stopper" lamp
description: A model to accompany the application for US Patent #239373, "Electric Lamp," filed 7 August 1880, issued 29 March 1881 to Thomas A. Edison. A hard rubber base-collar, single-arch bamboo filament with two-piece leads, platinum-clamps. ... Edison never put this lamp design into production.
